description: The TAISYS JUISE-S2 is a contact/contactless module that provides security services targeted at mobile devices in a single Integrated Circuit Chip. The module is implemented upon Sun Java Card ™ 3.0.4 Classic Edition specifications and is also compliant with GlobalPlatform Card Specification - Version 2.2.1 with SCP03.

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
